title: Operations Manager
description:
VIRAT SCRAPERS Job Description Operations Manager Company 
 Virat Scrapers Location 
 To be specified Experience Required 
 510 years (scrap/metal trading, recycling, or industrial operations preferred) Reports To 
 Director / Business Head 
 About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Operations Manager to oversee the end-to-end operational functioning of our scrap trading and recycling business — from yard operations and logistics to vendor coordination and government e-auction/tender participation (MSTC, GeM, and other public procurement portals). 
 Key Responsibilities Operations & Yard Management Oversee day-to-day scrap yard operations including material intake, sorting, weighment, storage, and dispatch Ensure optimal utilization of yard space, manpower, and equipment Implement and monitor SOPs for safety, quality control, and material handling Procurement & E-Auction / Bidding Track and evaluate scrap/material tenders and e-auctions listed on MSTC, GeM, and other relevant portals Coordinate bid preparation, documentation, and submission within deadlines Liaise with the finance team for EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) and payment processing related to successful bids Maintain a tracker of ongoing, upcoming, and completed auctions/tenders Logistics & Vendor Management Manage transportation and logistics for inbound and outbound material movement Negotiate and manage relationships with transporters, vendors, and scrap suppliers Ensure timely delivery and compliance with contractual terms Compliance & Documentation Ensure adherence to statutory and regulatory requirements (GST, weighbridge certification, environmental clearances, etc.) Maintain accurate records of purchases, sales, and auction participation for audit purposes Team & Process Management Supervise yard staff, drivers, and support teams Drive process improvements to reduce operational costs and improve turnaround time Prepare periodic MIS reports on operational performance, procurement status, and auction outcomes 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, or related field (MBA preferred) Prior experience with MSTC / GeM portal bidding or government e-procurement is highly desirable Strong understanding of scrap/metal trading operations and logistics Proficiency in MS Excel and basic MIS reporting Strong negotiation, vendor management, and team leadership skills Ability to work under tight auction/tender deadlines 
 Preferred Background Experience in scrap trading, metal recycling, steel/e-waste industry, or industrial procurement Familiarity with CPPP, IREPS, or state e-procurement portals is a plus

Key Skills: Operations Management,Production Operations,Lead Operations,Process Management,Business Operations,Operations Planning,Operations,Production Operation
